summary: Two big biomarker bets failed on outcomes: pelacarsen (Lp(a), Novartis) and ziltivekimab (IL-6, Novo) both hit their target and did not cut cardiovascular events.
Obesity drugs kept widening their reach: oral orforglipron cut sleep apnea severity; survodutide passed its cardiovascular safety test.
Gene editing moved from concept to lipid data: one-time CTX310 cut triglycerides about 63% in 10 patients.
AI was everywhere, but only on workflow: no AI trial showed fewer hard clinical events.
topics: IL-6 inflammation inhibition in cardiovascular disease
Oral GLP-1 drugs beyond weight loss (sleep apnea)
